access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-08 via the Smithsonian Open Access API (ids.si.edu delivery). A Potawatomi man at an 1827 treaty: a white shirt, a black kerchief knotted at the neck, a grey-white blanket over both shoulders, a cloth wrapped round the head with a silver band and coloured feathers, and a broad band of dark paint across the eyes. Treaty dress and paint, not everyday dress, and fifteen years after 1812.
what_it_supplies: a Potawatomi man of the 1820s drawn from life: shirt, blanket worn over the shoulders, a cloth head wrap
what_it_does_not_supply: everyday dress: it was taken at a treaty, with paint and feathers that the 14 August figure does not wear
